statusTitle: No openings right now. Hiring opens soon.
statusText: We are not hiring today, but we will open careers and internships soon. Join the list and we will email you the moment a role goes live.

culture.title: Ship real work
culture.description: Everything we build goes to real users, so you learn how products are made, tested and released.

culture.title: Learn from builders
culture.description: You work next to the engineers and designer doing the work, with reviews and regular demos.

culture.title: Own your part
culture.description: You take a piece of a project and see it through, from first idea to launch.

culture.title: Plain communication
culture.description: Clear updates, honest feedback and no unnecessary layers.

process.name: Apply
process.detail: Send your CV, GitHub or portfolio, and a short note about what you want to work on.

process.name: Conversation
process.detail: A chat with our engineers about your projects and what you have built.

process.name: Practical task
process.detail: A small, real-world task related to the role. No trick questions.

process.name: Offer
process.detail: We share the decision and next steps quickly.
